customMethods.name: getData
customMethods.script:
self.view.custom.filters.assetId
	startDate = self.view.custom.filters.startDate
	endDate = self.view.custom.filters.endDate
	assetId = self.view.custom.filters.assetId
	assetPath = self.view.custom.filters.assetPath or ''
	
	assetPath += '%'

	self.view.custom.data.kpiSummary = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getMaintenanceKPISummary({'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'assetId': assetId}),0)
	self.view.custom.data.mtbfSummary = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getMaintenanceMTBFSummary({'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'assetId': assetId}),0)
	self.view.custom.data.kpiByAsset = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getMaintenanceKPIByAsset({'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'assetId': assetId}))
	self.view.custom.data.mtbfByAsset = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getMaintenanceMTBFByAsset({'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'assetId': assetId}))
	self.view.custom.data.kpiTrend = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getMaintenanceKPIDailyTrend({'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'assetId': assetId}))
	self.view.custom.data.backlog = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getMaintenanceBacklogAging({'assetPath': assetPath}))
	self.view.custom.data.workflowChurn = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getMaintenanceWorkflowChurn({'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate}))
	self.view.custom.data.laborHoursSummary = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getMaintenanceLaborHoursSummary({'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'assetId': assetId}),0)
	self.view.custom.data.laborHoursByTechnician = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getMaintenanceLaborHoursByTechnician({'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'assetId': assetId}))
	self.view.custom.data.laborHoursByWorkOrder = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getMaintenanceLaborHoursByWorkOrder({'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'assetId': assetId}))
	
	return
